title: Groups and arrays
summary: Read arrays both ways, find missing groups, and spot unequal groups.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 totals a three-by-five array. Q2 counts its rows. Q3 finds the total with rows reversed. Q4 describes a smaller array. Q5 finds how many fives make twenty without a counting pile. Q6 spots unequal groups. Q7 shares thirty between three without an unrelated array. Q8 compares array totals. Q9 finds how many tens make thirty. Q10 recognises a reversed array as the same total.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses small equal groups of 2 and 5, totals to 10, sharing into 2, and grouping 10 into twos. Medium uses totals to 30, groups of 10, and grouping versus sharing stories. Hard reads an array both ways, finds a missing number of rows, and spots unequal groups. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
